government_scholarships.name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) – Central Sector Scheme
government_scholarships.eligibility: Family income below INR 4.5 lakh/year; scored above 80% in 12th; fresh undergraduate
government_scholarships.how_to_apply: Register at scholarships.gov.in with Aadhaar; select Central Sector Scheme

government_scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship – Karnataka Government (SC/ST Students)
government_scholarships.eligibility: SC/ST students; pursuing post-10th studies; family income below INR 2.5 lakh/year
government_scholarships.contact_college: student affairs office for college verification

government_scholarships.name: OBC Post-Matric Scholarship
government_scholarships.eligibility: OBC category; family income below INR 1 lakh/year
government_scholarships.how_to_apply: NSP Portal or SSP Karnataka Portal

government_scholarships.name: AICTE PG Scholarship (for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students)
government_scholarships.eligibility: Students with valid GATE score admitted to M.E./M.Tech at AICTE-approved institution
government_scholarships.how_to_apply: Apply through AICTE portal; college forwards application

government_scholarships.name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS)
government_scholarships.eligibility: Wards of ex-servicemen / Coast Guard personnel

government_scholarships.name: Minority Scholarship – Maulana Azad National Fellowship
government_scholarships.eligibility: Minority community students (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Zoroastrian); pursuing M.Phil/Ph.D

government_scholarships.name: Pragati Scholarship (AICTE) – For Girl Students
government_scholarships.eligibility: Girl students in AICTE-approved institutions; family income below INR 8 lakh/year; 1 per family
government_scholarships.amount: INR 50,000/year (tuition, books, incidentals) – 2 scholars per state per program

government_scholarships.name: Saksham Scholarship (AICTE) – For Differently-abled Students
government_scholarships.eligibility: Specially-abled students (40% or more disability); pursuing degree/diploma at AICTE institution

college_internal_schemes.name: GITS Merit Scholarship
college_internal_schemes.eligibility: 12th score >= 90% for 1st year; CGPA >= 8.5 for subsequent years
college_internal_schemes.apply_to: Admissions Office during admission or Student Affairs Office (by July 31 each year)

college_internal_schemes.name: GITS Need-Based Fee Waiver
college_internal_schemes.eligibility: Family income below INR 3 lakh; financial hardship demonstrated
college_internal_schemes.waiver: 10%–30% of tuition fee based on committee assessment

college_internal_schemes.name: GITS Research Fellowship
college_internal_schemes.eligibility: M.E. / Ph.D. students engaged in active research; supervisor recommendation

education_loan_assistance.process: Student approaches bank with bonafide certificate + fee structure + income proof. College finance office provides support letters.
education_loan_assistance.vidyalaxmi_portal: vidyalakshmi.co.in – Central portal for education loan applications

student_accident_insurance.scope: Death or permanent disability due to accident on or off campus
student_accident_insurance.premium: Covered in annual student activity fee
student_accident_insurance.claim_process: Contact Student Affairs Office within 30 days of incident with FIR / medical reports

health_insurance.coverage: Cashless hospitalisation up to INR 50,000 per year
health_insurance.eligible_hospitals: Empanelled hospitals list available at Medical Centre
